finding.trace: RigInfluences public f32 weights are not checked by PackedRigSkin word admission. strongest_four merges duplicate joints, sorts by descending total with ascending ordinal ties, takes four, sums and divides. A nonempty all-zero row yields retained entries with a zero denominator and NaN output; WIDTH=0 has no retained iteration and does not divide. Separately, two finite f32::MAX values on the same joint overflow their merged f32 sum to infinity, and infinity/infinity is NaN. These are IEEE/source reasoning scenarios, not values or operations executed here.
finding.consumer_qualification: Runtime equipment mesh calls the reducer and inserts its output; no local input check is shown in the inspected lines, while upstream reachability remains open. The inspected GLB input validator rejects zero or nonfinite total before export reduction and checks array lengths; do not assert an all-zero row passes that exporter. Total-only validation does not itself prove each component is nonnegative. An illustrative [2,-1,0,0,0,0,0,0] row sums to1, but whether negative weights should be allowed remains an explicit policy question.
